groundScope: Static medium-fi exterior based on Schmidt1970 measured elevations/plans and inspected2010/2016 photographs. Original14038-triangle draft remains unchanged. Reviewed source adds jagged stair scar, raised eight-step remnant/rubble and the north roof slab displaced60cm at its west end.14.12m maximum height/7.30m nominal side retain measured original dimensions; slight settled/sloping base differences are simplified. Eight preserved original steps are distinguished from missing original lower/upper access; stair datum1.08m and rubble shapes are approximate. Twenty-one large-block courses average irregular historic jointing; local repairs/cracks and exact engravedGreek/Parthian/Pahlavi text are omitted rather than fabricated. Roof cramp marks are original geometric indications, not a measured cavity survey. Hidden chamber, buried foundations, detached archaeological fragments, modern railings and the entire excavation cut are outside the individual monument exterior. The host terrain must supply the excavated floor datum; a coarse surrounding-gradeDEM will bury the base. Ground0 does not certify the hostDEM or site cut. Footprint replacement disabled.
